author: _Cromwell_
body:
You are ahead of me. I have been on that quest since the spring, which I think is when it came out. Honestly I don't remember it's been so long... I got through the one before it pretty fast so it was pretty much when that whole line was introduced. I am at 20 of 25. I'm Tier 8 so they don't really spawn. If I were lower they would spawn apparently more often , and if I were higher there's some sort of other thing I could go into (I've been told) where they appear more often ... But I'm in the middle so no luck .Have to just randomly see them or try to run low-level gauntlets wasting my keys. Terrible game design honestly. I like many things about this game but there are some really really really really really really really really terribly thought out and implemented design decisions. This quest is one of them.

There is already code and functionality in the game to make things that you have quest for spawn in some circumstances. For the life of me I don't know why they just don't implement a light version of that "buff" on constantly in the background.  When you make a game and you put things like quests into them you would think you would want your game features to actually be enjoyable to the people playing your game.  And it makes no sense to give people quests that they almost can't find the solutions for. If this was some sort of rare quest it would make sense for it to take months and months and be hard to seek out and find, but this is just the newbie line as far as I understand. lol. Weird game. So enjoyable in some ways and so infuriatingly stupid in others.
